scope: Remaining original portal, imported platform, workspace and release work; work packages do not assert completion.
focus: Platform absorption remains the current priority; portal dependencies can be completed without waiting for the whole platform port.

execution_policy.unit: One complete workflow batch with its route, adapter, presentation, errors and source trace. A package may require several named batches.
execution_policy.verification_threshold: Finish the named workflow batch before the full test/build/Docker loop. Use targeted diagnostics earlier only to resolve a concrete implementation blocker.
execution_policy.completion: Run relevant checks and real Docker/API journey, record evidence and remaining gaps, then commit and push the coherent batch. Mark a package done only after all its batches and acceptance checks pass.
execution_policy.overlap: Each behavior has one package owner. Shared source files may reference multiple packages; do not build duplicate transports or UI.
execution_policy.gates: Dependencies include technical prerequisites and the requested platform-before-workspace sequence. Visual/accessibility/error standards apply during every batch, with P5 as the final portal audit.

packages.title: Shared registry and navigation
batches: Use the active schema for navigation and capability drift; preserve original view and field links.
Complete server-side pagination, dynamic filters/sorting and reference lookup pagination as one list workflow.
Complete record and item-action navigation without introducing another registry UI.
acceptance: Multiple pages and filtered/sorted results match actual server queries; reference choices do not silently truncate.
Deep links and return navigation work through reload; unsupported views and server errors are explicit.

packages.title: Typed editors, blobs and Sievepad
batches: Finish size/duration/date, enum-map keys and specialized original field editors; keep typed wire values and stable list keys.
Implement registry blob upload/download and failures against the engine contract.
Complete original Sievepad edit/validate/save workflows using the shared transports.
acceptance: Nested edits and blobs persist through reload; server-owned properties are preserved and rejected writes retain drafts.
A Sieve script can be edited, validated and reopened with real validation failures shown.

packages.title: Identity, MFA and browser setup
batches: Complete discovery/registration, PKCE callback, account selection, expiry, sign-out and return navigation.
Complete OTP enrollment/recovery and login with real MFA accounts.
Finish the browser bootstrap wizard with complete variant fields, one-time credentials and restart behavior.
acceptance: Clean disposable browser setup produces usable permanent credentials and disables temporary setup access.
Normal/MFA login, expiry and sign-out pass real positive and negative journeys; no cross-account session reuse.

packages.title: Actions, delivery and observability
batches: Verify every real action variant, permission failure and returned result, including DMARC.
Complete delivery stage details, successful SMTP/TLS outcomes, cancellation and disconnect behavior.
Connect archived trace/detail routes and finish live metrics/tracing filters, node selection and stream lifecycles.
acceptance: Actions show actual method results; delivery and trace streams close on completion, navigation, cancellation and failure.
Supported-edition telemetry works against real services; unavailable editions retain explicit disabled states.

packages.title: Visual, accessibility and localization parity
batches: Apply keyboard, focus, responsive and accessible error behavior in every earlier batch; finish the full parity audit here.
Restore original locale/translation coverage, description rendering, icons, branding and font subsets.
acceptance: Original capability and visual matrix has a disposition and behavioral evidence for every original screen.
Keyboard, narrow-screen and accessibility checks pass; text and formatting match the chosen locale.

packages.title: Imported platform integration and source route ledger
batches: Review the imported baseline and remaining reference dispositions without recopying maintained files.
Enumerate every source platform route/action with roles, API and destination owner; create feature-family port batches from this ledger.
Run the existing Go service and database in a documented disposable topology; establish the real identity/API boundary with Svelte.
acceptance: All imported source routes and pending references have dispositions and no feature is silently dropped.
Go API authentication and tenant authorization work in the disposable deployment; no fabricated identity/API contract.

packages.title: Tenant, installation and target ownership
batches: Define and implement explicit platform tenant, mail tenant, installation and deployment target bindings.
Bind credentials and authorization to the selected installation; distinguish desired placement from observed running state.
acceptance: Two tenants cannot read or mutate each other's bindings, credentials or targets.
A selected installation resolves to its owned mail service; a failed or stale binding cannot silently target another installation.

packages.title: Dedicated, shared and hybrid runtime lifecycle
batches: Dedicated batch: provision an owned isolated installation, configure credentials and confirm provider/mail read-back.
Shared batch: provision a mail tenant/domain/account on the assigned installation and prove tenant isolation.
Hybrid batch: implement explicit per-tenant placement and reviewed movement between supported placements.
Lifecycle batch: reconcile actual state, upgrades, rollback, deletion, backup/recovery and failures through existing review/provider boundaries.
acceptance: Each placement mode passes its own real provision/use/failure/cleanup journey; a saved request is never reported as a running service.
Migration, rollback and recovery retain the intended tenant data and enforce the exact authorized target.

packages.title: Svelte port of the imported platform feature families
batches: Port complete feature-family workflows from the C1 source route ledger, starting with identity/setup and infrastructure/hosts.
Complete tenants/projects/workspaces, catalog/deployment controls and the remaining source admin/customer/integration families.
Use shared Svelte tokens and adapters; retire reference React routes only after their source workflow proves parity.
acceptance: Every source platform route/action is accounted for in Svelte with real role/error/API behavior.
Instance controls operate on the bound target and display actual observed state; no mail reload presented as fleet lifecycle.

packages.title: Mail, calendar and contacts
batches: Complete mail search/paging, safe bodies, attachments, draft/compose/reply/forward/send and folders.
Complete calendar and contact create/edit/delete and their permissions with the same session.
acceptance: Real compose/send/receive/search and attachment journeys pass across reload.
Calendar/contact mutations persist and cross-account denial is verified.

packages.title: Drive file lifecycle
batches: Complete hierarchy, upload/download, move/delete, quotas, sharing, conflict and pagination against FileNode/blob APIs.
acceptance: File content and location persist after reload; quota, conflict and sharing boundaries hold for two accounts.

packages.title: Documents and wider-network integration
batches: Establish the actual document editor/storage/collaboration and network identity contracts from owned services.
Implement document create/edit/reopen, sharing and conflicts through the established service adapters.
acceptance: Real editor and network journeys pass with tenant authorization and recovery; an unavailable contract remains an explicit dependency.

packages.title: Compatibility, packaging and cutover
batches: Complete legacy /admin and /account deep-link/OAuth compatibility and versioned packaging.
Prove install/upgrade/rollback, original route coverage, isolation and recovery; retire duplicate runtime/context only after these gates.
acceptance: Clean install and upgrade preserve routes, credentials and data; rollback is reproducible.
Every original webui and imported platform capability has passing proof or an explicit supported-edition disposition.
